title: Why does PUNCHING Sonic 3D trigger a Secret Level Select?
summary: A short Coding Secrets episode explaining why hitting a Sonic 3D cartridge triggers a hidden level select. The cause was a custom crash handler that redirected CPU error interrupts to the level select screen.
why: Shared as a favorite game-development anecdote with a clear technical explanation.
